answer.title: Daily Customer Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggers every working day at 16:00 to prepare daily reminder calls.
steps: Generate the list of customers who need a reminder call for the next working day
Draft a friendly reminder script for each customer
Queue the call list and notes for review
answer.ai_help: Summarize customer booking details and draft personalized reminder notes.
answer.human_approval: Claire reviews the call list and approved reminder notes before dialing.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes only result in an incorrect reminder call time, which can be quickly corrected over the phone.
